provenance.factories: explicit registration sites (textual scan of registerBuiltins bodies)

limitations.classes: line-anchored textual scan of src/**/*.H; not a C++ parse (templates/nested/macro declarations unseen -- avoided by convention in this tree)
limitations.includes: the compiler's own -MMD output; ground truth for compile-time reach, silent about runtime reach
limitations.callGraph: DELIBERATELY ABSENT: dispatch goes through virtuals and explicit factories, so a static call graph would be wrong; use `factories` for the name->type minting and `includesReverse` for the compile-time blast radius
limitations.freshness: regenerate after moving/adding files; check_code_map fails when stale
